purpose: ETL pipeline scripts: convert xlsx to jsonl, process with Claude loops, validate, write back to xlsx

prepare.py.intent: Convert xlsx source files to jsonl format for pipeline processing. Creates source.jsonl (read-only truth) and work.jsonl (mutable working copy)

finalize.py.intent: Convert work.jsonl back to xlsx for upload to Yandex Market. Only modifies changed cells
finalize.py.outputs: Modified xlsx file for Market upload

validate.py.intent: Validate work.jsonl after Ralph Loop runs. Checks for common errors per loop type (characteristics, names, descriptions, instructions)

generate_progress.py.intent: Create progress.json grouping products by group_name for Ralph Loop queue management

write_result.py.intent: Safe write interface for Claude to update work.jsonl. Validates input before writing to prevent formatting errors

source.jsonl.intent: Read-only truth data extracted from original xlsx (old names + descriptions)

work.jsonl.intent: Mutable working copy with all columns, modified by pipeline loops
work.jsonl.outputs: JSON lines with all product fields
